transcript.text: Salieri. These are serious charges for a man in your position. I value your service, but I must hear your account. Explain yourself.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer

Ah, Your Majesty, I stand before you accused of actions that I assure you are greatly exaggerated and misconstrued. As Kapellmeister, it is my duty to uphold the standards of musical excellence at the court. If certain compositions or appointments were not deemed suitable, it was because I believed they would not contribute positively to the artistic reputation we strive to maintain.

Allow me to address the matter of young Mozart. While it is true that I have reservations about his unconventional style and methods, it is not out of personal interest or malice that I have expressed concern. My intention is to safeguard the integrity of the court's musical traditions and ensure that only the most deserving and capable musicians are given prominent positions.

As for the cancellation of rival operas, I must clarify that my decisions are based solely on artistic merit and the overall coherence of the season's programming. It is not in my nature to engage in petty rivalries or sabotage the works of others out of spite.

Your Majesty, I am a servant of music above all else, and I have dedicated my life to honoring and preserving the art form that we all hold dear. I humbly ask for your understanding and trust in my judgment as Kapellmeister, as I continue to fulfill my responsibilities with the utmost sincerity and dedication.

To quell these allegations, I need from you an assurance of fairness and impartiality that reflects the dignity of your office. Convince me further that these accusations are without basis and that our court is, and will remain, a bastion of musical excellence and equitability.
